json_group_array(v) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value AS v FROM json_each(basis.baseline,'$.components') WHERE typeof(value)='text' AND value<>'' ORDER BY v)),'[]') || '|' || COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(v) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value AS v FROM json_each(basis.baseline,'$.tags') WHERE typeof(value)='text' AND value<>'' ORDER BY v)),'[]') || '|' || COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(v)
